verdict.rationale: Pendo documents an official SDK for mobile apps and public developer APIs across Native Android, Native iOS, React Native, Flutter and Xamarin. It also offers a JavaScript install snippet for web, so developers can build against first-party SDKs. Missing for 10: server-side or backend language SDKs for the REST API, published SDK reference depth or an OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Install the Pendo SDK to provide analytics and guides across all of your mobile apps.
Pendo provides public developer APIs for the following frameworks: Native Android, Native iOS, React Native, Flutter, Xamarin Forms, Xamarin Maui
Install and configure Pendo by inserting a JavaScript code block directly into your application.
